info.title: Council of AI — GSPC measurement (public read surfaces)
info.description: Independent AI-behaviour measurement by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement, not certification. Quote totals.lid and totals.public_count from GET /api/gspc verbatim; never compose a count. Three verification states exist: VALID, INVALID, UNCHECKABLE. Absence of a field means UNMEASURED. TIE is never a win. A withheld leader (public_leader_state) is a state, not a zero. Verify is free; a rank is never sold. Signature checks are not Actions: use /signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY.md.

get.summary: The living GSPC board — the one authority
get.description: Returns totals (print totals.lid and totals.public_count verbatim), state_enum, and one object per axis with status, kind, separation, and either a public leader or a public_leader_state explaining why the leader is withheld (EXCLUDED_OWN_MODEL, NO_SIGNED_CARD). Do not count the axes array; read totals.

get.summary: One free inclusion proof against the last published public root
get.description: Pass sha=<64-hex>. 200 with kind=inclusion (index, proof[], merkle_root, as_of) when the sha is a leaf; 404 error=not_found when it is not a leaf (the root binds the public-root card set, not every signed measurement card); 400 when sha is malformed. bundle=1 is an x402 (HTTP 402) paid re-serve, never required.

404.description: Not a leaf of the last published root.

get.description: Ed25519-signed envelope under did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1; card_sha256[] is bound by merkle_root. Recipe: /signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY-ROOT.md. Not a certificate.

get.summary: The DID document that publishes the signing keys
get.description: verificationMethod[] carries the Ed25519 keys (card-attestation-1 signs measurement cards; board-attestation-1 signs the root and mill cards). Pin, do not fetch at check time.

get.summary: Unsigned convenience index of the signed measurement cards
get.description: cards[] with card (id), axis, card_url, signed. The index itself is not evidence; the card is.
{alg, body, id, preimage_rule, pubkey, signature}. id = sha256 of the canonical body; verify per /signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY.md. Returns 404 for an unknown id.
